newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: S.Korea denies defector met CIA official.
newsitem.headline: S.Korea denies defector met CIA official.

text.p: South Korea's Foreign Ministry on Monday denied reports that a North Korean defector taking refuge in the South's Beijing embassy had met a U.S. intelligence official and revealed plans by other Northern officials to flee.
"No U.S. official has met Hwang Jang-yop," a ministry spokesman said.

The state-run Korea Broadcasting System and local newspapers reported on Monday that Hwang had told an official from the U.S Central Intelligence Agency (CIA) that six to seven officials of North Korea's ruling Workers' Party wanted to seek political asylum.
"The news reports are not true at all," spokesman Lee Kyu-hyung told Reuters.
Hwang, a senior aide to North Korean leader Kim Jong-il, has been in the South Korean mission in Beijing since Wednesday while China, an ally of Pyongyang, agonised over his fate.
Seoul has said Hwang sought asylum in South Korea, but North Korea has said Seoul kidnapped him.
